feature: LMS.ContentService — MongoDB-backed content service with Azure Blob Storage (Azurite in dev), async processing worker, multipart upload + SAS playback URLs, MassTransit publish/consume

tasks.title: Add ContentUploaded + ContentProcessingFailed records to LMS.Contracts
tasks.spec: Add src/LMS.Contracts/Content/ContentUploaded.cs and src/LMS.Contracts/Content/ContentProcessingFailed.cs as sealed records exactly per .claude/contracts.md section 3. Add src/LMS.Contracts/Content/ContentType.cs enum (Video, Pdf, Image, Other) with identical ordinal values to the Domain enum. Do NOT modify the existing ContentProcessingCompleted.cs. Mirror XML-doc style of existing Content/ContentProcessingCompleted.cs. Defer docs/events.md updates to T11.

tasks.title: Scaffold 4-project layout for LMS.ContentService
tasks.spec: Create the four projects under src/services/LMS.ContentService/ (Domain, Infrastructure, Api, Worker) mirroring LMS.CourseService project metadata exactly (TFM net9.0, ImplicitUsings, Nullable). Worker replaces Migrator. Project references per contracts.md section 1. Add all four projects to LMS.slnx. Empty class-library shells for Domain/Infrastructure; Program.cs stubs in Api+Worker. Api launchSettings.json port 5103. ServiceDefaults reference on Api+Worker.

tasks.title: Domain layer: documents, enums, repository + storage + processor interfaces, DTOs
tasks.spec: Implement ITenantDocument, ContentDocument base, ContentItem document, ContentType + ContentStatus enums per contracts.md section 2. Define IContentItemRepository (every method takes Guid tenantId), IContentStorageService per contracts.md section 5 (UploadAsync streaming bytes, GetDownloadUriAsync returning SAS Uri, DeleteAsync, OpenReadAsync), IVideoProcessor with ProcessAsync returning ProcessingResult record. Add response DTO records (ContentItemDto, PlaybackUrlDto, Page<T>) per contracts.md section 6. Define ITenantContext interface mirroring CourseService.Domain pattern.

tasks.title: Infrastructure: Mongo context, repos, Azure Blob storage, processor stub, MassTransit outbox + DI
tasks.spec: Implement ContentMongoContext (IMongoDatabase wrapper) reading ConnectionStrings:lms-content. Implement MongoContentItemRepository with explicit tenantId predicate on every operation per contracts.md section 2. Implement IndexInitializer hosted service to create indexes on startup. Implement AzureBlobContentStorageService using Azure.Storage.Blobs SDK: inject BlobServiceClient via Aspire.Azure.Storage.Blobs (AddAzureBlobClient("content-blobs")); use container 'lms-content' (configurable via AzureBlob:Container); ensure-create container on startup; UploadAsync streams to BlobClient.UploadAsync; GetDownloadUriAsync uses BlobClient.GenerateSasUri(BlobSasPermissions.Read, expiresOn). StorageKeyBuilder enforces {tenantId}/{contentItemId}/... prefix and rejects cross-tenant paths (UnauthorizedAccessException). Implement StubVideoProcessor (Phase 1) producing fake HLS/thumb keys + duration. Wire MassTransit MongoDB outbox (AddMongoDbOutbox) — fall back to in-memory outbox if MassTransit.MongoDb unavailable. Provide AddContentInfrastructure(IConfiguration) DI extension consumed by both Api and Worker. Required NuGet packages: Aspire.Azure.Storage.Blobs (~9.4.1-preview.1.25408.4), Azure.Storage.Blobs, MongoDB.Driver, MassTransit.MongoDb.

tasks.title: Api layer: multipart upload endpoint, ContentUploaded publish, query endpoints, Program.cs
tasks.spec: Implement all endpoints per contracts.md section 6 with Minimal API endpoint groups: POST /uploads (accepts multipart/form-data; streams file part to IContentStorageService.UploadAsync; persists ContentItem with Status=Uploaded; publishes ContentUploaded via outbox; returns 201 ContentItemDto), GET /{id}, GET /{id}/playback (calls GetDownloadUriAsync for HLS manifest with 60 min TTL; returns 409 if Status != Ready), GET / (list with paging), DELETE /{id} (soft delete). HeaderTenantContext + TenantHeaderMiddleware reads X-User-Id, X-Tenant-Id, X-Roles. FluentValidation enforces mime/size limits. Configure Kestrel MaxRequestBodySize and FormOptions.MultipartBodyLengthLimit to Content:MaxVideoSizeBytes. Wire ServiceDefaults, AddContentInfrastructure, ProblemDetails, FeatureManagement, OpenTelemetry. Listen on port 5103.

tasks.title: Worker: ContentUploaded consumer, processing flow, publishes ContentProcessingCompleted/Failed
tasks.spec: Implement Worker Program.cs as a generic host running MassTransit. Add ContentUploadedConsumer per contracts.md section 7: idempotent (skip if Status != Uploaded), flips Status Uploaded->Processing->Ready, calls IVideoProcessor (stub), generates SAS download URI for HLS manifest with 60 min TTL via IContentStorageService.GetDownloadUriAsync, publishes ContentProcessingCompleted via outbox. On exception publishes ContentProcessingFailed and sets Status=Failed. UseMessageRetry intervals 1s,5s,30s. Reuse AddContentInfrastructure.

tasks.title: Aspire AppHost: register MongoDB lms-content, Azure Storage (Azurite emulator) + content-blobs, content Api, content Worker
tasks.spec: Apply AppHost diff in contracts.md section 8: ensure contentDb is registered as 'lms-content'. Add Azure Storage resource via builder.AddAzureStorage("storage").RunAsEmulator() (uses Azurite in dev). Add storage.AddBlobs("content-blobs"). Register content Api with port 5103, .WithReference(contentDb).WithReference(rabbitmq).WithReference(contentBlobs).WaitFor(contentDb).WaitFor(contentBlobs).WaitFor(rabbitmq). Register content-worker with same references. gateway.WithReference(content). Add NuGet package Aspire.Hosting.Azure to LMS.AppHost.csproj. Verify gateway appsettings.json already routes /api/content/{**rest} to 'content' cluster — confirm in spec output. If gateway has a tight MaxRequestBodySize, raise it to accommodate large multipart uploads (≤ 5 GiB).

tasks.title: Integration + unit + architecture + contract tests
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md section 10. Use xunit-integration skill: WebApplicationFactory + Testcontainers (Mongo + Azurite via mcr.microsoft.com/azure-storage/azurite + RabbitMQ) + MassTransit test harness. Tenant isolation pair on /api/content/{id}. Multipart upload to POST /api/content/uploads persists blob under {tenantId}/{contentItemId}/original/{filename} and returns 201. Upload publishes ContentUploaded. Worker consumer test (consume ContentUploaded -> publishes ContentProcessingCompleted). Playback 409 when not Ready, 200 with SAS Uri when Ready. Soft delete -> 404. Architecture: every Domain document implements ITenantDocument; every IContentItemRepository method has Guid tenantId param. Contract tests for ContentUploaded, ContentProcessingCompleted, ContentProcessingFailed shapes.

tasks.title: Tenant isolation + auth + storage-key audit
tasks.spec: Run tenant-isolation skill against ContentService (Mongo variant — no global filter; verify every repo call has explicit tenantId predicate). Verify (a) no endpoint trusts a body-supplied TenantId; (b) SAS URIs never expose cross-tenant blob paths; (c) StorageKeyBuilder rejects paths outside the caller's tenant prefix; (d) consumers honour message TenantId; (e) no JWT validation downstream — only X-* headers; (f) Azure Blob container created with private access (no anonymous read); (g) SAS TTL bounded (≤ 60 min) and Read-only permissions; (h) multipart upload size limits enforced before bytes hit Blob Storage.
acceptance: audit report with zero high-severity findings

tasks.title: Code review against contracts + LMS absolute rules
tasks.spec: Use code-reviewer skill. Cross-check every document field, event shape, endpoint path, DTO, and AppHost wiring against .claude/contracts.md. Verify Mongo-equivalent tenant safety pattern. Verify 4-project layout. Verify no direct HTTP between services. Verify ILlmClient not bypassed (n/a here). Verify event records in LMS.Contracts only. Verify Azure Blob client is injected via Aspire.Azure.Storage.Blobs (not constructed manually with raw connection strings).
acceptance: review report with all violations resolved or explicitly waived

tasks.title: Author docs/services/content.md, sync entities.md + events.md + architecture.md + README
tasks.spec: Create docs/services/content.md with shipped endpoints, Azure Blob conventions ({tenantId}/{contentItemId}/... paths, Azurite in dev), Worker flow, consumed/published events. Update docs/entities.md ContentService section to match locked ContentDocument/ContentItem shape (Id Guid surrogate, StorageContainer + StorageKey replacing S3Key, ContentStatus values). Update docs/events.md to add EventId to ContentProcessingCompleted, add ContentUploaded and ContentProcessingFailed records. Note ContentService is now wired into AppHost on port 5103 with Azure Blob Storage (Azurite emulator). Update README service checklist to mark ContentService done.
